meta.purpose: first small-sample reachability and simplified-collision check over a parametric bed

bed.length_assumption: 2.0 m is an assumption, not a measured bed

robot_base.clearance_definition: gap between base front face and bed near side

collision_model.type: temporary capsules for arm links, oriented box for torso, AABB for base and bed
collision_model.sampling: 21 points per capsule segment for box distances
limitations: no patient, bedding, rails, frame or soft contacts
arm-arm check uses the other arm at P0, not a joint solution
negative clearance means overlap in the simplified model

ik.nullspace_sampling: +/-3 and +/-6 degrees along each analysis null-space direction
